metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for tropospheric NO₂ measurements. - Compare two time periods: Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020. - Taiwan geography: approximately 120°E-122°E, 22°N-25°N. - Collection: `COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI` (near-real-time) or `COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL` (offline/corrected). 2. **Masking Strategy**: - S5P data has quality assurance (QA) flags; filter by `qa_value >= 0.5` to ensure valid pixels. - No cloud masking needed as S5P is a passive sensor measuring atmospheric column concentrations. - Exclude pixels with low QA values. 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check image collection size for both periods (C1 if 0). - Check valid pixel count after QA filtering (C2 if 0). - Check if mean NO₂ values are valid numbers within plausible range (~0-5 µmol/m²) (C3 if NaN or out of range). - Compare means: if Feb mean < Apr mean → A (Yes), else B (No). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Taiwan geometry const taiwanGeom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([120.0, 22.0, 122.5, 25.5]); // 2. Define time periods const feb_start = '2020-02-10'; const feb_end = '2020-02-26'; const apr_start = '2020-04-20'; const apr_end = '2020-05-13'; // 3. Acquire S5P NO2 data for February const s5p_feb = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL') .select('NO2_column_number_density') .filterBounds(taiwanGeom) .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_FRACTION', 0.3)); const feb_size = s5p_feb.size().getInfo(); console.log('Feb Images: ' + feb_size); if (feb_size === 0) { console.log('No data for February 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Acquire S5P NO2 data for April-May const s5p_apr = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL') .select('NO2_column_number_density') .filterBounds(taiwanGeom) .filterDate(apr_start, apr_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_FRACTION', 0.3)); const apr_size = s5p_apr.size().getInfo(); console.log('Apr-May Images: ' + apr_size); if (apr_size === 0) { console.log('No data for April-May 2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NO2 for February const feb_mean_img = s5p_feb.mean(); const feb_mean = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), taiwanGeom, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // 6. Calculate mean NO2 for April-May const apr_mean_img = s5p_apr.mean(); const apr_mean = apr_mean_img.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), taiwanGeom, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // 7. Check for valid pixels const feb_count = feb_mean_img.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), taiwanGeom, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const apr_count = apr_mean_img.reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.count(), taiwanGeom, 1000, null, null, false, 1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log('Feb Valid Pixels: ' + feb_count + ', Mean NO2: ' + (feb_mean ? feb_mean.toFixed(4) : 'null')); console.log('Apr Valid Pixels: ' + apr_count + ', Mean NO2: ' + (apr_mean ? apr_mean.toFixed(4) : 'null')); // 8. Validation if (feb_count === 0 || apr_count === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (feb_mean === null || apr_mean === null || isNaN(feb_mean) || isNaN(apr_mean)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Compare means if (apr_mean > feb_mean) { console.log('Feb: ' + feb_mean.toFixed(4) + ' µmol/m² → Apr: ' + apr_mean.toFixed(4) + ' µmol/m²'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Feb: ' + feb_mean.toFixed(4) + ' µmol/m² → Apr: ' + apr_mean.toFixed(4) + ' µmol/m²'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
